title: Patroni
description: Patroni cluster health from the metrics Patroni's REST API serves at /metrics, as collected by the startechnica/grafana postgres_metrics module's patroni declare. Panels select by metric name, not by job, so a Patroni scraped some other way shows up too. Clusters are told apart by Patroni scope (and cluster_name when it is set), so a scope must be unique within the datasource otherwise.

list.name: scope
list.label: Cluster
list.description: Patroni scope: the cluster name in patroni.yml.

panels.title: Clusters
panels.description: Patroni clusters (scopes) with at least one member reporting.

targets.expr: count(group by (cluster_name, scope) (patroni_version{scope=~"${scope:regex}"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Members reporting
panels.description: Members whose Patroni REST API is being scraped successfully.

targets.expr: count(group by (cluster_name, scope, name) (patroni_version{scope=~"${scope:regex}"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Members not reporting
panels.description: Members that reported at some point in the last 7 days but not now: the node is down, its Patroni REST API hangs or refuses the scrape, or the collector that scrapes it is down. The Members table lists them with Scraped = no. A member is its name on its instance, so relabeling its scope or job does not make it look missing. A member removed on purpose keeps counting here for up to 7 days.

targets.expr: count(group by (name, instance) (last_over_time(patroni_version{scope=~"${scope:regex}"}[7d])) unless on (name, instance) patroni_version) or vector(0)

panels.title: Clusters without a leader
panels.description: Clusters in which the members see no leader lock in the DCS. No member may run as primary, so writes fail until Patroni elects a leader.

targets.expr: count(max by (cluster_name, scope) (patroni_cluster_unlocked{scope=~"${scope:regex}"}) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Replicas not streaming
panels.description: Running replicas with no WAL stream from the primary. They fall behind, and one that falls further behind than maximum_lag_on_failover cannot be promoted.

targets.expr: count(patroni_replica{scope=~"${scope:regex}"} == 1 and patroni_postgres_running{scope=~"${scope:regex}"} == 1 and patroni_postgres_streaming{scope=~"${scope:regex}"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Paused clusters
panels.description: Clusters in maintenance mode (patronictl pause): Patroni does not fail over while paused.

targets.expr: count(max by (cluster_name, scope) (patroni_is_paused{scope=~"${scope:regex}"}) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Members
panels.description: One row per member, as each member's Patroni reports itself. Replay lag is how many bytes of the leader's WAL a replica has not replayed yet; above maximum_lag_on_failover (1 MiB by default) Patroni will not promote it. It compares positions from separate scrapes, so on a busy leader it also counts WAL written between them. DCS contact is the time since Patroni last reached the DCS, measured at the scrape. Scraped = no marks a member that reported in the last 7 days but not now, so every other column is empty for it.

targets.expr: max by (cluster_name, scope, name, instance, job) (patroni_primary{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} + 2 * patroni_standby_leader{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} + patroni_replica{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} * (3 + patroni_sync_standby{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} + 2 * patroni_quorum_standby{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"}))
max by (cluster_name, scope, name, instance, job) (patroni_postgres_state{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"})
max by (cluster_name, scope, name, instance, job) (patroni_postgres_timeline{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"})

max by (cluster_name, scope, name, instance, job) ((patroni_postgres_streaming{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} + 2 * patroni_postgres_in_archive_recovery{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"}) and patroni_replica{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} == 1 or patroni_replica{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} * 0 - 1)

max by (cluster_name, scope, name, instance, job) (clamp_min(max by (cluster_name, scope) (patroni_xlog_location{scope=~"${scope:regex}"} and patroni_primary{scope=~"${scope:regex}"} == 1) - on (cluster_name, scope) group_right () (patroni_xlog_replayed_location{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} and patroni_replica{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} == 1), 0) or patroni_replica{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} * 0 - 1)

max by (cluster_name, scope, name, instance, job) (timestamp(patroni_dcs_last_seen{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"}) - patroni_dcs_last_seen{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"})
max by (cluster_name, scope, name, instance, job) (patroni_pending_restart{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"})
max by (cluster_name, scope, name, instance, job) (patroni_is_paused{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"})

max by (cluster_name, scope, name, instance, job) ((time() - patroni_postmaster_start_time{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"}) and patroni_postmaster_start_time{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} > 0 or patroni_postmaster_start_time{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} * 0 - 1)

max by (cluster_name, scope, name, instance, job) (patroni_version{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} * 0 + 1) or on (name, instance) (max by (cluster_name, scope, name, instance, job) (topk by (name, instance) (1, max_over_time(timestamp(patroni_version{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"})[7d:10m])) * 0) unless on (name, instance) patroni_version)

panels.title: Role
panels.description: Each member's role over time. The leader changing hands is a failover or a switchover; a gap means the member was not scraped.

targets.expr: max by (cluster_name, scope, name) (patroni_primary{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} + 2 * patroni_standby_leader{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} + patroni_replica{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} * (3 + patroni_sync_standby{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} + 2 * patroni_quorum_standby{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"}))

panels.title: Postgres state
panels.description: Postgres as Patroni manages it. Blue states are transitions (starting, restarting, creating a replica); red ones are failures that need a look at the Patroni log.

targets.expr: max by (cluster_name, scope, name) (patroni_postgres_state{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"})

panels.title: Replay lag
panels.description: Bytes of the leader's WAL each replica has not replayed yet. The dashed line is Patroni's default maximum_lag_on_failover (1 MiB): a replica further behind is not promoted. The leader's and the replica's positions come from separate scrapes, so on a busy leader this also counts the WAL written between the two.

targets.expr: max by (cluster_name, scope, name) (clamp_min(max by (cluster_name, scope) (patroni_xlog_location{scope=~"${scope:regex}"} and patroni_primary{scope=~"${scope:regex}"} == 1) - on (cluster_name, scope) group_right () (patroni_xlog_replayed_location{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} and patroni_replica{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"} == 1), 0))

panels.title: Timeline
panels.description: The Postgres timeline each member runs on. It steps up by one on every promotion; Patroni reports 0 while Postgres is not running.

targets.expr: max by (cluster_name, scope, name) (patroni_postgres_timeline{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"})

panels.title: DCS contact age
panels.description: Seconds since each member's Patroni last reached the DCS, measured at the scrape. A leader that cannot renew its lock within ttl (30s by default) demotes itself unless failsafe_mode keeps it up.

targets.expr: max by (cluster_name, scope, name) (timestamp(patroni_dcs_last_seen{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"}) - patroni_dcs_last_seen{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"})

panels.title: Cluster flags
panels.description: Paused: maintenance mode, no automatic failover. Failsafe: the DCS is unreachable and failsafe_mode is what keeps the primary running. No leader lock: no member holds the leader key.

targets.expr: max by (cluster_name, scope) (patroni_is_paused{scope=~"${scope:regex}"})
max by (cluster_name, scope) (patroni_failsafe_mode_is_active{scope=~"${scope:regex}"})
max by (cluster_name, scope) (patroni_cluster_unlocked{scope=~"${scope:regex}"})

panels.title: Member flags
panels.description: Pending restart: a changed parameter takes effect only after a restart (patronictl restart). Replay paused: a replica whose WAL replay was paused by hand, so it serves older and older data.

targets.expr: max by (cluster_name, scope, name) (patroni_pending_restart{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"})
max by (cluster_name, scope, name) (patroni_xlog_paused{scope=~"${scope:regex}", name=~"${member:regex}"})
